order_wins: **Welspun Corp** - wholly-owned Welspun Tubular LLC **wins the largest order in its history, about USD 412.5 million (~Rs 4,000 crore as stated), for HFIW pipes from its upgraded Little Rock mill**, to execute in FY28-FY29 _(~5.6% of mcap)_.

**Vascon Engineers** - receives a **letter of intent worth Rs 660.79 crore including taxes from Qualcomm India to design and build a three-basement, ground-plus-12 office block in Bengaluru** on a GMP contract, due within 30 months _(~85.7% of mcap)_.

**Lakshya Powertech** - secures a **Rs 276.38 crore order from Vedanta Oil & Gas for integrated operations and maintenance of the Cairn Ravva asset in Andhra Pradesh** over three years plus two provisional years _(~254.2% of mcap; SME)_.

**Blue Cloud Softech Solutions** - US subsidiary Global Impx **signs a US$15.5 million (~Rs 147 crore as stated) fixed-fee statement of work from IBM Cloud to design, deploy and support an AI infrastructure environment** in New Jersey _(~8.1% of mcap)_.

**Optivalue Tek Consulting** - receives a **letter of intent from Aerial IQ India for 100 tethered drone systems for a proposed iDEX order from the Ministry of Defence**, at a tentative minimum of Rs 70 crore, terms still under negotiation _(~13.0% of mcap)_.

**Praruh Technologies** - receives a **one-year RailTel rate contract worth Rs 31.21 crore to supply telepresence equipment with five years' maintenance**, with orders to follow as separate sub-purchase orders _(~13.7% of mcap)_.

**Abhishek Integrations** - receives a **Rs 3.15 crore letter of intent from the Airports Authority of India to operate and maintain iron-removal plants, pumps and electrical installations at Kolkata airport** over 24 months _(~15.9% of mcap)_.

**Skytech Infinite Platform** - receives a **Rs 1.15 crore purchase order from Gradiant India to commission a redundant PLC control system for Vikram Solar's effluent treatment plant** in Tirunelveli _(~3.8% of mcap)_.
**Cosmic CRF** - bags **purchase orders of Rs 13.30 crore including GST from a Kolkata infrastructure company for 1,650 tonnes of cold-formed Z sheet piles**, due within six months _(~1.1% of mcap)_.
**Cosmic CRF** - subsidiary N.S. Engineering Projects **bags four purchase orders totalling Rs 13.02 crore including GST from a Kolkata infrastructure company** _(~1.1% of mcap)_.

**Seshaasai Technologies** - wins a **three-year tendered contract, as one of two successful bidders, to print and handle policy bond kits for an unnamed public-sector life insurer**; value not disclosed, revenue tied to volumes.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Aditya Infotech** - **allots 43,26,507 shares at Rs 3,467 in its qualified institutions placement, about Rs 1,500 crore**, closing the issue opened on 22 September; Aditya Birla Sun Life Mutual Fund schemes take 8.33% _(~3.5% of mcap)_.
**Natco Pharma** - board fixes a **2-for-21 rights issue of 1,70,58,082 shares at Rs 750, up to Rs 1,279.36 crore**, record date 1 October, open 12 to 22 October _(~8.5% of mcap)_.

**Aequs** - board approves **2,80,71,690 warrants at Rs 231.55, Rs 650 crore, to the promoter Melligeri Private Family Foundation, with Rs 325 crore upfront**, subject to a 22 October EGM _(~4.0% of mcap)_.

**Aimtron Electronics** - board approves a **preferential issue of up to 12,24,265 shares at Rs 1,674.47, about Rs 205 crore, to seven AIF schemes led by Clarus Capital's Rs 120 crore**, subject to a 22 October EGM _(~5.5% of mcap)_ _(★ PROPOSED allotment to Alchemy Capital Management (Hiren Ved); Niveshaay (Arvind Kothari))_.

**Kabra Extrusiontechnik** - receives **BSE and NSE in-principle approval for a preferential issue of 37,60,000 shares at Rs 375, Rs 141 crore**, to promoter-group and non-promoter investors _(~5.0% of mcap)_.

**Tusaldah** - board approves, subject to shareholders, **buying promoter-held Tusaldah Ventures for 29,09,299 shares at Rs 20, plus a cash issue of 29,47,271 shares and 63,50,000 warrants at Rs 20**, about Rs 18.59 crore of cash (our arithmetic).
**NMS Global** - receives **BSE in-principle approval for 1,17,03,500 warrants at not less than Rs 72 to non-promoters**, at least Rs 84.27 crore at that floor (our arithmetic).
**Safa Systems & Technologies** - receives **BSE in-principle approval for up to 23,90,000 shares at Rs 20.47, Rs 4.89 crore, to promoters and the promoter group** _(~9.8% of mcap)_.
equity_allotments: **Precision Wires India** - allots **37,50,000 compulsorily convertible debentures at Rs 400, Rs 150 crore, to Anchorage Capital Scheme-III and AADI Financial Advisors**, converting into equity after 12 to 18 months - a new preferential issue _(~1.7% of mcap)_.
**Antariksh Industries** - allots **22,25,000 shares at Rs 86, Rs 19.14 crore, on a preferential basis to promoter, non-promoter and public investors** - a new share issue.

**Khadim India** - allots **10,22,727 warrants at Rs 110, about Rs 11.25 crore (our arithmetic), on 25% upfront**, to promoter Siddhartha Roy Burman and ten public investors - a new warrant issue _(~5.3% of mcap)_.
**Aurique** - allots a **second tranche of 73,50,700 warrants at Rs 12, about Rs 8.82 crore (our arithmetic)**, to two allottees, after 98,38,200 on 23 September - a new warrant issue.
**Sampre Nutritions** - allots **17,70,710 shares at Rs 42, Rs 7.44 crore, to Brahma and Meera Gurbani on converting an unsecured loan** - a new preferential issue _(~13.0% of mcap)_.

**CWD** - allots **1,15,654 shares on converting warrants against a Rs 7.87 crore balance at 75% of the Rs 907 issue price**, plus 4,62,616 bonus shares on them, to non-promoters - a past conversion _(~1.2% of mcap)_.
**Jet Freight Logistics** - allots **45,19,663 shares at Rs 18 on conversion of warrants, against Rs 6.10 crore received**, mostly from three promoter-group members - a past conversion.

**Gretex Industries** - allots **1,97,800 shares at Rs 236, Rs 3.50 crore, to promoter-group Gretex Corporate Services** as the second tranche of converting warrants approved in 2025 - a past conversion.
**Hemo Organic** - allots **34,00,000 shares at Rs 12.50 on converting warrants**, on receipt of the 75% balance from non-promoter holders - a past conversion.
**Aimtron Electronics** - allots **1,77,800 equity shares at Rs 680.64 on conversion of warrants issued in September 2025** to non-promoters; 3,50,934 warrants remain outstanding - a past conversion.
**Sadhana Nitrochem** - receives **BSE and NSE trading approval for 6,75,00,000 shares of Re 1 allotted to non-promoters at a Rs 1.06 premium** in its preferential issue, tradable from 25 September.
m_and_a: **Edelweiss Financial Services** - group **completes selling 45% of Nido Home Finance to Carlyle affiliate CA Sardo Investments and Aditya Puri's Salisbury Investments for Rs 580.68 crore**; Nido ceases to be a subsidiary.

**Oriana Power** - **receives the first-tranche consideration for selling its stake in Truere Guj SPV, a ~70 MWp solar and 30 MWh battery project, to Actis group's Leo Energies**, at an enterprise value of about Rs 325 crore _(~10.5% of mcap)_.

**R R Kabel** - **executes a business transfer agreement to buy Usha Martin subsidiary U M Cables' optical fibre cable business for Rs 77 crore in cash** on a slump-sale basis, its entry into the segment.

**Novus Loyalty** - **signs definitive share purchase agreements to buy 54.873% of fintech AutoPe Payment Solutions**, in cash in two instalments per agreement, following its 31 August term sheet; consideration not stated in the pages read.

**QMS Medical Allied Services** - board approves a **scheme merging its and Health Care at Home's patient-support businesses into subsidiary Saarathi Healthcare**; QMS's unit turned over Rs 37.17 crore, 24.41% of its FY26 total.
**Emerald Tyre Manufacturers** - **invests Rs 12.23 crore for 64.44% of South Africa's SA Rubber Engineering**, which becomes a subsidiary, completing a deal disclosed in January _(~7.9% of mcap)_.

**Innomet Advanced Materials** - **completes buying 57.5% of tungsten-powder maker Swastik Tungsten**, taken over out of insolvency with nil turnover, by subscribing Rs 1.50 crore of new shares at Rs 30.
**Chandan Healthcare** - **acquires the two Ghaziabad units of Ansh Diagnostics & Health Care**, a pathology and radiology provider including CT and MRI; value not disclosed.

**Steelman Telecom** - board approves **selling 0.61% of EC Wheels India to three employees including the CFO for Rs 7.50 lakh**, cutting its stake to 49.47% so EC Wheels, 18.94% of last year's turnover, ceases to be a subsidiary.

**Kalpataru Projects International** - Swedish step-down subsidiary **Linjemontage lists on Nasdaq Stockholm at SEK 46 a share**, a SEK 2,357 million valuation; KPIL retains about 65.9% and its holding company receives about SEK 711.5 million gross.

**Kotak Mahindra Bank** - wholly-owned **Kotak Mahindra Investments is to merge into Kotak Alternate Asset Managers**, after its lending book moved into the bank under RBI's 2025 directions; subject to RBI and other approvals.

**Dabur India** - **NCLT New Delhi sanctions the amalgamation of Ayurvedic hair-care brand Sesa Care into Dabur**, with an appointed date of 1 April 2026, completing a deal first announced in October 2024.

**Adani Power** - the **amalgamation of ten wholly-owned subsidiaries becomes effective on 25 September**, after NCLT Mumbai sanctioned the Vidarbha Industries Power leg on 24 September; appointed date 1 April 2025.

**Kansai Nerolac Paints** - **NCLT Mumbai sanctions the amalgamation of Nerofix into the company**, appointed date 1 April 2025, effective once the certified order is filed with the Registrar of Companies.
**Siemens** - **NCLT New Delhi approves cancelling the 0.78% of C&S Electric held by other shareholders**, which will make the 99.22%-owned subsidiary wholly owned once implemented.
**GOCL Corporation** - the **NCLAT Chennai directs NCLT Amaravati to convene the shareholder meeting on merging Hinduja National Power Corporation into GOCL**.
**CIE Automotive India** - **NCLT Mumbai issues directions on shareholder meetings** for absorbing wholly-owned aluminium die-caster CIE Aluminium Casting India, a scheme its board approved in April.
**Primo Chemicals** - board approves **merging wholly-owned chlorinated-paraffin and hydrochloric-acid maker Flow Tech Chemicals into itself**, with an appointed date of 1 October 2026.
**Bhagyanagar India** - fixes **8 October as the record date for issuing one Tieramet share for every share held** under its composite scheme with Bhagyanagar Copper.
**Sammaan Capital** - **NCLT New Delhi admits the second-motion petition on its scheme with Sammaan Finserve** and lists the matter for 16 November.
**Magnum Ventures** - **NCLT Allahabad pronounces its first-motion order on the scheme of arrangement with Magnum Paperz**, uploaded on 25 September.
capex_core: **Endurance Technologies** - **starts commercial production at its greenfield AURIC Shendra aluminium die-casting plant** for ICE, EV and non-auto parts, at 900 tonnes a month expandable to 1,100.

**Suraj Estate Developers** - a wholly-owned subsidiary **completes buying development rights to a 2,941 sq m plot beside Suraj One Business Bay in Mahim for Rs 82.72 crore**, with a stated estimated GDV of about Rs 800 crore _(~7.9% of mcap)_.

**Ellenbarrie Industrial Gases** - **commissions a 325 tonnes-per-day air separation unit at Jai Balaji Industries' Durgapur plant** under a 15-year take-or-pay onsite gas supply agreement, with revenue starting this month.

**JSW Energy** - wholly-owned JSW Thermal **orders two 800 MW steam turbine generators for Salboni Phase II from associate Toshiba JSW**, completing turbine orders for the whole 3,200 MW West Bengal project; value not disclosed.
**Godawari Power and Ispat** - receives an **offer letter from Maharashtra Industrial Township for a 31.45-acre plot at AURIC Bidkin** to set up its CRM project.
**Metalic Technoforge** - board approves **leasing industrial premises at Talawade, Pune for a new manufacturing facility**; plant, machinery and consideration are still being finalised.
business_updates: **Results season** — 56 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.

**Signatureglobal (India)** - **buys 25 acres and signs collaboration agreements for 169.22 more at Farrukhnagar, Gurugram, for a farmhouse-villa project** of about 6.77 million sq ft, projecting GDV of Rs 5,500-6,000 crore; consideration not disclosed.

**CESC** - renewable arm Purvah Green Power **signs its first commercial-and-industrial deal, a 25-year supply from a 49.5 MW Madhya Pradesh wind project to Prism Johnson**, which will invest up to Rs 40 crore for 26.5% of the project company.

**Constronics Infra** - solar subsidiary Constronics Energy Solutions **signs a 25-year power purchase agreement with ELGI Equipments and Tablets (India) for 7.85 MWp**, who take 31.15% for Rs 2.80 crore; it expects about Rs 5.20 crore of annual revenue.

**Bharat Coking Coal** - **signs an MoU with SAIL to jointly develop its East of Damagoria (Kalyaneshwari) block and SAIL's Indikatta Ramnagore block in West Bengal**, with combined peak rated capacity of 4.0 million tonnes a year.

**Prestige Estates Projects** - **launches Prestige Parklane, 1,788 homes across 11.91 acres on Bengaluru's STRR-Devanahalli corridor**, about 1.7 million sq ft with a stated gross development value of about Rs 1,750 crore.

**Arihant Superstructures** - subsidiary Dwellcons **signs a hotel operating agreement with ITC Hotels for a 227-room 'Mementos by ITC Hotels' at its World Villas project**, projecting Rs 150-200 crore annual revenue at maturity - a projection, not booked.

**Rhetan TMT** - **signs a 24-month MoU under which Bajaj Tubular Products intends to buy about 20,000 tonnes of TMT bars** through individual purchase orders; its Rs 250-300 crore figure is management's estimate, not a contracted value.
**PVR INOX** - **opens a five-screen, 814-seat multiplex at MyMoon, Kochi**, taking its network to 1,797 screens across 358 properties in 114 cities.
**Lemon Tree Hotels** - **opens the 71-key Lemon Tree Resort, Nashik**, against the 57 rooms disclosed in 2024, its second property in the city in two days.
**Easy Trip Planners** - electric-mobility arm EMTev **debuts its electric buses in Bhopal** and says it is building capability to manufacture 5,000 electric buses a year within five years.

**Axiom Gas Engineering** - the Auto LPG retailer **plans to add petrol and diesel, undertake terminal projects and expects its first import consignment within three weeks**; impact not yet quantifiable.
**Dhanuka Agritech** - **launches products in India including the Wetcit Neo spray adjuvant and Fujita, an isoprothiolane fungicide for rice blast**.
**Monolithisch India** - says its **SGB refractory lining ran a 32-heat campaign at Shree Ram Multimetals against a 22-25 heat peer norm**, with more plants in commercial trials.

**Jyoti Global Plast Limited** — Jyoti Global Plast Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated September 25, 2026, titled "Jyoti Global Plast Limited Secures Order Worth Rs. 5.01 Crore from Paras Defence and Sp
distress_risk: **PB Fintech** - tells analysts the **new insurance-distribution regulations leave general-insurance net present value at one-third to 40% of today's**, a 'very serious impact on revenue', with life broadly unchanged; it is weighing cost cuts.

**LG Electronics India** - receives a **customs show cause notice proposing recovery of Rs 153.58 crore of duty**, after a DRI probe alleging royalty payments were left out of imported goods' assessable value; no penalty imposed yet.

**Sunteck Realty** - receives a **GST show cause notice for Rs 59.44 crore including interest and penalty over transferable development rights bought in FY23**; it says no GST applies and the notice counts the amount twice.
**Sanofi India** - receives a **Karnataka GST show cause notice for FY23 proposing Rs 23.74 crore, including Rs 14.43 crore of tax**, over excess input tax credit; it is preparing a response.

**ICICI Bank** - receives a **West Bengal GST show cause notice demanding Rs 16.76 crore including interest and penalty** on charges to customers keeping minimum balances, an issue it is already litigating.

**Fortis Healthcare** - promoter Northern TK **appeals to the Tokyo High Court against the 10 September judgment in its claim against Daiichi Sankyo**, and parent IHH plans to raise its Fortis stake to 51% over three to five years.

**Kalpataru** - wholly-owned Ananta Landmarks receives a **GST show cause notice for Rs 14.00 crore including interest and penalty for FY23**, over reverse-charge payments and disallowed input credit; it will contest.

**Everest Industries** - receives a **Maharashtra GST show cause notice for FY23 demanding Rs 13.34 crore**, including Rs 7.32 crore of tax, over input credit and under-declared liability; it sees no material impact.
**Rane Holdings** - wholly-owned Rane Steering Systems receives **GST show cause notices for Rs 10.07 crore including a Rs 0.92 crore penalty** over ineligible input tax credit in FY23 and FY24.

**NGL Fine-Chem** - receives a **Maharashtra GST show cause notice for FY23 proposing Rs 6.19 crore**, including Rs 3.04 crore of tax, over unmatched input credit and short-paid output tax; hearing 22 October.
**Aarti Surfactants** - a **customs order reclassifying imported amines confirms Rs 1.43 crore of differential duty and a Rs 1.54 crore penalty**, and confiscates goods; it will appeal to CESTAT.
**Styrenix Performance Materials** - receives an **income tax assessment order for AY 2023-24 with a demand of Rs 1.93 crore**.
**Vikran Engineering** - receives a **Rajasthan GST show cause notice for FY23 seeking about Rs 0.84 crore of tax and Rs 0.63 crore of interest** over unmatched input credit.
**UCAL** - receives a **Maharashtra GST audit show cause notice for FY23 demanding Rs 0.88 crore including interest** over excess input tax credit.
**G R Infraprojects** - **files a writ petition in the Madhya Pradesh High Court, Indore** challenging the Ratlam GST show cause notice it disclosed on 26 August.
**G-TEC Jainx Education** - wholly-owned Keerti Institute receives a **Maharashtra GST audit show cause notice for FY23**; no amount is disclosed.

**Cemantic Infra-Tech** - four shareholders **seek the removal of managing director G. Satyanarayana and promoter director Kodali Vijaya Rani**; the company says their holding is under challenge before NCLAT, and a Section 241-244 petition is before NCLT.
**Zicom Electronic Security Systems** - **NCLT Mumbai approves Advaita Trading's resolution plan** for the company, by an order dated 24 September, ending its insolvency process begun in 2021.
**VAS Infrastructure** - sole secured creditor **Canara Bank rejects promoter Jayesh Valia's Section 12A settlement proposal**, so the insolvency process continues.
**Jalan Transolutions** - the **NCLT New Delhi orders fresh notice in Capital Trade Links' Section 7 insolvency matter over an alleged loan default**, listing it for 28 October.
**Osia Hyper Retail Limited** — Replacement of IRP and appointment of Mr. Vinod Tarachand Agrawal as the Resolution Professional of Osia Hyper Retail Limited (In CIRP)
**SKIL Infrastructure** - its resolution professional **convenes the twelfth committee-of-creditors meeting for 28 September** in the insolvency process running since February 2024.
**TV Vision** - its resolution professional **holds the second committee-of-creditors meeting on 25 September** in the company's insolvency process.
open_offers: **Mapro Industries Ltd** — Arambhveer Limited open offer (21.81 lakh shares) at Rs 60.13 vs CMP 70.41 (-14.6%); change of control (Reg 4) + >25% acquisition (Reg 3(1)); **DO NOT TENDER - market pays more than the offer**; tender window not in PA (comes with DPS/LoF); mcap Rs 58 cr
credit_rating_changes: **Bharat Seats** - **ICRA upgrades its long-term rating to A+(Stable) from A(Stable) and reaffirms A1**, across Rs 188.96 crore of facilities including an enhanced term loan.
**Agi Infra** - **India Ratings upgrades subsidiary Worldnext Realty's Rs 1,425.5 million of bank loans to IND BB+/Stable** and affirms its bank guarantee at IND A4+; the prior level is not stated.
**ANB Metal Cast** - **Acuite assigns a first rating of BBB/Stable on Rs 59 crore of bank facilities**, citing growth to Rs 225.19 crore of FY26 operating income.
**STL Networks** - **Infomerics assigns IVR A-/Stable to Rs 250 crore of long-term bank loan facilities**.
**GP Eco Solutions India** - **Infomerics assigns IVR BBB/Stable long-term and IVR A3+ short-term ratings**.
other_notable: **Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers** - board approves **placing a Rs 797 crore (plus taxes) purchase order on Larsen & Toubro to revamp an ammonia plant** for lower specific energy consumption, over 36 months; money going out _(~13.3% of mcap)_.
**Hitech Corporation** - receives **BSE's in-principle approval for the voluntary delisting of its equity shares**, with the final application due within a year of the special resolution.
**Jain Irrigation Systems** - says it has **repaid about Rs 246.72 crore of NCDs and term debt since July**, discharging every obligation due up to 30 September ahead of schedule.

**One 97 Communications (Paytm)** - **puts Rs 100 crore into wholly-owned Paytm Money through a rights issue** and lifts its Little Internet stake to 77.42% from 62.53%; money going into its own group.

**Godrej Industries** - **invests about Rs 335 crore more in wholly-owned Godrej Investment**, the core investment company holding Godrej Capital and Godrej Wealth & Asset Management; an intra-group transfer.
**Ceigall India** - with a subsidiary, **commits Rs 61.93 crore of equity to the SPV for its NHAI Sahebganj-Bettiah hybrid-annuity highway** and approves security for the SPV's term loan.

**Fischer Medical Ventures** - board approves **subscribing to rights issues by three wholly-owned material subsidiaries**, Time Medical International Ventures, FlynnCare Health Innovations and FMV Global Innovation; money going into its own group.
